name: Deific Bolt
body:
School evocation [see text]; Level antipaladin 1, cleric/oracle 1, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Effect bolt of divine energy
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You launch a bolt of divine energy at your target. The nature of the divine bolt varies depending upon the deity or creed that grants you your powers. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with the bolt to deal damage to the target. The bolt deals 1d6 damage plus 1d6 per 2 levels (max 5d6). Additionally, if hit, the target is limned in the energy imposing a -5 penalty on Stealth checks and a -1 penalty to AC for 1 round. The spell gains the alignment descriptor corresponding to your deity’s or creed’s alignment.
